title: ThinkBit: Search Codewords, Recalibrate Scales, Select by Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34886v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning language models generate thousands of tokens per answer, and generation speed is limited by memory bandwidth, so storing weights in two bits instead of bfloat16 can potentially make inference 8$\times$ cheaper. Two-bit methods are usually judged by perplexity and multiple-choice question-answering accuracy, both of which say little about whether a model can still reason through more difficult problems. We present ThinkBit, a strictly scalar two-bit framework built to preserve reasoning, in which every weight is an integer codeword times a bfloat16 scale shared by a group of weights. We first use a sensitivity metric to assign each layer a ternary, 2-bit, or 3-bit tier to allocate bitwidths optimally among layers. This is followed by a layerwise Gumbel-softmax-based scalar quantization algorithm that searches for optimal codewords block by block. translated_title: ThinkBit：搜索码字、重新校准缩放因子、以推理为准进行选择
translated_abstract: 推理型语言模型每次回答会生成数千个token，其生成速度受内存带宽限制，因此若用2比特而非bfloat16存储权重，有望将推理成本降低8倍。现有2比特量化方法通常以困惑度和选择题问答准确率来评判，但这两项指标几乎无法反映模型是否仍能对更困难的问题进行推理。我们提出ThinkBit，一个严格基于标量的2比特量化框架，专为保持推理能力而设计，其中每个权重都表示为一个整数码字乘以由一组权重共享的bfloat16缩放因子。我们首先使用敏感度指标为每一层分配三值、2比特或3比特的层级，以在层间最优地分配比特宽度；随后采用一种基于Gumbel-softmax的逐层标量量化算法，逐块搜索最优码字。由于逐层方案无法捕捉量化层之间的相互作用……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ThinkBit是一种旨在保持大语言模型推理能力的严格标量2比特量化框架，它通过层敏感度分配各层比特宽度、用Gumbel-softmax逐块搜索最优码字并重新校准缩放因子，有望将推理成本降低8倍。
